name: order_haptoglobin
description: Orders a serum haptoglobin test. Haptoglobin binds free hemoglobin released from lysed red blood cells. Low levels indicate intravascular hemolysis. Used in hemolytic anemia workup.
when_to_use: Evaluation of unexplained anemia with elevated LDH and bilirubin
Monitoring hemolysis in sickle cell disease

args.clinical_indication: anemia with schistocytes on blood smear
